title: H-D X440 S Top Variant (Adventure Spec)
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Harley-Davidson H-D X440 S Top Variant (Adventure Spec) is purpose-built to crush coast-to-coast highway miles and conquer rugged backcountry tracks. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, backed by a 5.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
